How HireHub works

A guided hiring and career journey designed around clarity, trust, and meaningful outcomes.

HOW HIREHUB WORKS

A clear, guided journey from first step to successful hire

01

Register your company

Create your employer account and set up your company profile in minutes.

02

Post a job

Add role details, location, pay range, and hiring timeline with structured fields designed for faster matching.

03

Choose your hiring approach

Select AI-assisted matching to receive curated candidates, or browse profiles directly using filters.

04

Connect with verified candidates

Review profiles with verification badges and reach out through the platform to schedule conversations.

05

Hire and close the role

Confirm your hire, close the job, and keep records organised within your dashboard.

Post a Job↗
01

Create your profile

02

Upload or build your CV

Upload an existing CV or use the AI CV builder to create a clear, structured profile.

03

Complete verification

04

05

Get hired

Connect with employers, attend interviews, and move into work with confidence.
